svg.text: (b) Charts, each on its own thread
(c) Then the band along the borders
84 edges over 1.5 L: 54 split now (green), 30 wait
every chart on its own thread; grey: the frozen ring of one
132 of 252 triangles in the band; grey: frozen
A split claims its two triangles; a collapse the triangles around both ends; a flip its four vertexes. Charts are made once; new triangles join their chart.
